summary: Verified the Hero part-search fix (HERO_ECATALOGUE_URL updated to https://ecatalogue.heromotocorp.biz:8080/HeroeCat/). All 7 targeted backend tests PASS: /api/ health, /api/auth/login (JWT), /api/hero/search 401 without auth, /api/hero/search returns real Hero eCatalogue results with count>0 and required fields (part_no/description/mrp) for '35010', '91201', '50201', and graceful count=0/parts=[] (200) for unknown 'ZZZZZ99999'. Total runtime ~36s.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroClient still uses synchronous `requests` inside async endpoints — can block the event loop up to httpx timeout (~25s) per call. Consider httpx.AsyncClient. (Carried over from iteration_2.)
server.py > 1100 LOC — worth splitting into routers as noted in iteration_2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero eCatalogue endpoint is now https://ecatalogue.heromotocorp.biz:8080/HeroeCat/ and reachable. /api/hero/search returns real parts. Test suite: /app/backend/tests/test_hero_search.py. Note the Hero calls are network-dependent and ~5s per query; if flakiness appears, retry once.
rca of the issue: Original bug: /api/hero/search returned 502 because HERO_ECATALOGUE_URL was set to a non-existent DNS host (ecatalogue.heromotocorp.com). Root cause: wrong domain. Fix (applied by main agent): updated backend/.env HERO_ECATALOGUE_URL to https://ecatalogue.heromotocorp.biz:8080/HeroeCat/ and restarted backend. Verified: search now returns real data for common part numbers and gracefully returns count=0 for unknown parts.
